label: Хорошо
description: A 10-sentence usage card for хорошо (well, good) covering manner, agreement, and feeling good.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner of action. 'Хорошо' means 'well' and modifies the verb 'готовит', describing the quality of the cooking. 'Очень' raises the degree of skill.
Strategic focus: Agreement word. Here 'хорошо' opens the sentence as a discourse marker meaning 'okay' or 'all right'. It signals acceptance before stating the agreement.
Strategic focus: Impersonal feeling. 'Хорошо' is an impersonal predicate meaning 'I feel good', with the dative 'мне' marking the experiencer. It expresses a pleasant state, not an action.
Strategic focus: Degree of knowledge. 'Хорошо' modifies 'знаешь', describing how thoroughly the city is known. The adverb sits before the verb for emphasis.
Strategic focus: Quality of action. 'Хорошо' modifies the past verb 'спал', describing restful sleep. 'Очень' intensifies the manner.
Strategic focus: Predicate of state. 'Хорошо' acts as a predicate meaning 'fine' or 'good', describing how things will turn out. This is a fixed, reassuring phrase.
Strategic focus: Skill in manner. 'Хорошо' modifies 'говорит', rating the quality of the Russian. The adverb directly before the verb is the standard placement.
Strategic focus: Manner with imperative. 'Хорошо' modifies the command 'подумай', urging careful, thorough thought. Here it means 'carefully' rather than literally 'well'.
Strategic focus: Behaviour quality. 'Хорошо' modifies the reflexive phrase 'себя ведут', describing good behaviour. This is a fixed everyday construction about conduct.
Strategic focus: Vividness of memory. 'Хорошо' modifies 'помню', meaning the memory is clear and strong. The adverb conveys degree rather than literal goodness.
